question: Using the National Vital Statistics Report on Birth Data from 2020, determine which three states had the highest birth rate among mothers aged 15-19 and which county, in each of these three states, had the most unmarried women aged 15-19 give birth in 2020? gold_answer: Mississippi: Rankin County, Arkansas: Pulaski County, Louisiana: Caddo Parish
